label: Ice / Polar
description: Frozen landforms as hero subjects — ice behaving as slow-motion rock.

items.name: glacier-cave
items.text: inside a glacier's meltwater cave, walls scalloped smooth by vanished water, the light arriving deep sapphire after meters of dense bubble-free ice

items.name: iceberg-arch
items.text: a sculpted iceberg arch drifting in slate-grey water, a wave-cut notch undercutting the waterline, nine-tenths of its mass invisible below

items.name: pancake-ice
items.text: rafts of pancake ice tiling an autumn freeze-up sea, every disc's rim raised by a thousand soft collisions with its neighbors

items.name: frozen-bubbles
items.text: columns of methane bubbles stacked in black lake ice, each stack rising from rotting matter on the bed, caught layer by layer as the winter ice grew downward

items.name: blue-crevasse
items.text: a crevasse field torn open where the glacier accelerates over a buried rock step, blue slots folding into depth, snow bridges sagging between them

items.name: rime-forest
items.text: trees armored entirely in wind-built rime feathers — ice grown into the wind, not with it — whole crowns fused into white flags

items.name: polar-plateau
items.text: the high polar plateau carved into sastrugi by one relentless prevailing wind, chisel-marked snow running unbroken to the horizon

items.name: ice-shelf-edge
items.text: the sheer front of an ice shelf meeting dark water in a hundred-meter wall, old snowfall strata banding the cliff, brash ice riding the swell at its foot

items.name: frost-flowers
items.text: frost flowers blooming across new black sea ice, each spiky cluster grown overnight from a single brine seed

items.name: calving-front
items.text: a glacier calving front mid-collapse, a tower of ice folding into the sea inside its own wall of spray
